newsitem.title: DUBAI: Fujairah bunkers soft ahead of Aramco prices.
newsitem.headline: Fujairah bunkers soft ahead of Aramco prices.

text.p: The 380 cst grade bunker fuel market at Fujairah, United Arab Emirates was assessed at $112-$114 a tonne on Wednesday and has the potential to fall further, bunker trading sources in the Gulf said.
Fujairah bunker prices have lost $4-$5 a tonne in the last eight days because of weaker Singapore markets and a fall in local bunkering demand.
"Business is pretty thin and the market has looked at the excess supplies in Far East cargoes," a trader said.
The weaker spot market is expected to be reflected in Saudi Aramco's weekly bunker prices which are due on Wednesday.
Fujairah 380 cst bunker prices have risen sharply since June in line with stronger crude fundamentals and are above the year-on-year comparison of $91.50 a tonne.
Fujairah is the third largest bunkering centre behind Singapore and Rotterdam, moving some 214,000 barrels per day of fuel.
